title: Infant with fever (caregiver interview)
goal: You are the clinician. Assess a febrile infant with the caregiver: cover temperature and timing, hydration, associated symptoms, and red flags, then confirm next steps.
opening: My baby has had a fever since last night and I am worried. She is only eight months old.

disclosures.response: It was 39.2 under the arm this morning. I gave her paracetamol and it came down a little, but it is climbing again.
It started last night around dinner. She felt hot when I picked her up.
She is drinking less than usual, and her last wet diaper was maybe six hours ago. That is not like her.
She has a runny nose and has been crying more than usual. No rash, and no vomiting.
She is quieter than her normal self, but she will still smile and reach for her toy. She is not limp.
No seizures, and her breathing looks normal to me. She was born at term and has had all her vaccinations.

metrics.name: Introduction and consent
metrics.rationale: Introduces self and establishes rapport with the caregiver.
metrics.coaching_hint: Introduce yourself and acknowledge the caregiver's concern.

metrics.name: Fever quantification and timing
metrics.rationale: Quantifies the fever and establishes onset and duration.
metrics.coaching_hint: Quantify the fever: 'What was her temperature, how did you measure it, and when did it start?'

metrics.name: Hydration and output
metrics.rationale: Assesses feeding, fluid intake, and urine output.
metrics.coaching_hint: Assess hydration: 'How much is she drinking, and how many wet diapers today?'

metrics.name: Associated symptoms
metrics.rationale: Asks about cough, breathing, rash, vomiting, and behavior.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about associated symptoms: 'Any cough, breathing trouble, rash, vomiting, or unusual crying?'

metrics.name: Red-flag screening
metrics.rationale: Screens for the red flags that need urgent evaluation.
metrics.coaching_hint: Screen for red flags: 'Any breathing trouble, unusual drowsiness, rash, or seizures?'

metrics.name: Shared next-step confirmation
metrics.rationale: Confirms the plan and checks the caregiver's understanding.
metrics.coaching_hint: Confirm next steps and check the caregiver's understanding before ending.
